result.headline: Throttle command dropped to zero at ~104.9 s with no mode event, and held to the end; altitude fell afterwards.
result.explanation: Propulsion command went to 0 % and the throttle channel held 1100 us for the last ~9 s, with no recorded event or mode change. The recording does not show who or what commanded it.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT propulsion.throttle was varying, then held 0 from t=104.889 s to the end of the recording (8.999 s, 23 samples)
evidence.shows: Throttle was cut to 0 % and stayed there to the end of the recording.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[2]] was varying, then held 1100 from t=104.996 s to the end of the recording (8.951 s, 27 samples)
evidence.shows: The propulsion output channel froze at its minimum. Its sibling outputs ch3, ch1, ch4 and ch5 kept moving.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[2]] follows propulsion.throttle (correlation 0.999 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: ch2 is the propulsion/throttle channel. It followed the command up to the cut, so the zero originates at or before the command, not in the output stage.

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[2]] at t=103.957 s: 1600 -> 1100 us (step -500, 62.5x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: A 500 us step on the throttle channel, the biggest step in the recording. Ordering against the sampled throttle is not resolved within about 1 s.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.714 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: The only events are at start-up (low-voltage warning and sensor-health error). Nothing is logged around the cut.

checked.check: Events list for any mode change, failsafe or operator event near the throttle cut
checked.result: Only 2 events, both at t=0.714 s (Battery low voltage WARN, System Sensor helth ERROR). None around the throttle cut.

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline over 90-114.1 s
checked.result: ch3 left baseline first (104.724), then throttle (104.889), then ch2 (104.996). Altitude (108.435), pitch tracking (112.483) and ch4/ch5 (113.385) followed.
The only frozen series are ch2 (1596 -> 1100 us, spread 0) and throttle (62 -> 0 %, spread 0). Roll tracking error stayed 2.073 -> 2.365 deg.
checked.about: Fault is local to the propulsion loop; attitude loops keep tracking

checked.check: Window 96-114 s of throttle, ch2, altitude and pitch
checked.result: Throttle rose 46 -> 64 %, then 51 at 104.439 s and 0 at 105.257 s. ch2 ran 1604 -> 1300 (104.724) -> 1100 (105.326). Altitude peaked at 51.78 m and fell to 39.915 m at the end. Pitch setpoint climbed to 17.48 deg.
checked.about: Altitude loss and pitch error are consequences of lost thrust

checked.check: Compare at 96.951 s (ch2 SHIFT) and 9.612 s (velocity SHIFT)
checked.result: At 96.951 s the changes are a ramp-up of throttle and a roll manoeuvre, not a fault; tracking ratios are ~1. At 9.612 s roll setpoint jumps to 44 deg and roll follows. Velocity x/y changes are heading changes.
checked.about: Earlier SHIFT lines as separate faults

checked.result: Roll error 1.67 -> 2.475 deg and pitch 1.511 -> 3.283 deg in the last stretch. Yaw error 4.158 -> 4.909 deg, similar to its 4.967 deg at 11-22 s. The roll and pitch increases follow the thrust loss.

effects.quote: SHIFT propulsion.throttle changed level for good at t=98.848 s: median 46 before, 0 after % (9.2x its variation before)

outcomes.label: Failsafe or mode change at the cut
outcomes.means: The autopilot cut thrust by design; the cause is the failsafe trigger, such as battery or sensor health.
outcomes.then: Trace the failsafe trigger back through battery or sensor data.

outcomes.label: RC throttle went to zero first
outcomes.means: The operator or RC link cut thrust; the throttle command followed the input.
outcomes.then: Check the RC link and operator action.

outcomes.label: Autopilot demanded thrust, output went 0
outcomes.means: Fault in the command or mixer path, or in the output stage or ESC.
outcomes.then: Bench-test the throttle output channel and ESC.

field_questions.question: Did the pilot cut throttle or trigger a kill/return switch late in the flight?
field_questions.why_needed: Separates an operator action from an autopilot or hardware cut.
field_questions.not_in_data: Searched events, ROLE and sheet lines: no RC input, mode, or operator series is recorded, and no event is logged around the cut.

if_answers.means: The throttle zero is an operator action; no hardware fault is indicated.

if_answers.answer: No, pilot did not touch it
if_answers.means: Autopilot failsafe, command-path or hardware fault stays open.

unobservable.fact: Whether the motor or ESC physically stopped, or only the command went to minimum
unobservable.why_it_matters: Separates command-side cut (autopilot or pilot) from motor or ESC failure (hardware).
unobservable.how_to_observe: Read ESC or motor telemetry if logged; otherwise bench-test the ESC and motor with a 1100 us signal.

hypotheses.claim: The flight controller commanded throttle to zero at ~104.9 s, which sent ch2 to its 1100 us minimum.
hypotheses.because: Throttle and ch2 both froze while other outputs kept moving; ch2 followed the throttle command (corr 0.999). No event explains the cut.
hypotheses.observed_at: controller throttle command and ch2 output readback

hypotheses.claim: A low battery voltage failsafe or supply collapse forced thrust to zero, linked to the start-up low-voltage warning.
hypotheses.because: A low-voltage WARN is recorded at 0.714 s, but no battery series exists to link it to the cut.

hypotheses.claim: The pilot or RC link cut throttle (kill switch, throttle stick or link loss).
hypotheses.because: No RC or mode series is recorded; nothing in the data separates an operator cut from an autopilot cut.
hypotheses.observed_at: none: not observed in this recording

hypotheses.claim: The ESC or motor output stage failed or latched off, leaving the channel at its minimum.
hypotheses.because: Only the commanded output is recorded; motor speed is not. ch2 followed the command, which points upstream, but the hardware is not observed.
hypotheses.observed_at: ch2 output readback, not the motor

hypotheses.claim: A fault in the roll, pitch or yaw control loops caused the failure.
hypotheses.because: Roll tracking held through the cut (2.073 -> 2.365 deg). Pitch and roll error grew after thrust was lost, not before.

events.what: Throttle and ch2 held at 0 % and 1100 us to end
events.why: Earliest and only frozen outputs, with no mode event.

events.what: Large drop of ch2 and throttle in the last 10 s
events.why: The cut itself; ch3 left baseline first.

events.what: Pitch and roll tracking error rise in the last stretch
Low-voltage WARN and Sensor health ERROR at start-up
events.why: Start-up events; they may or may not link to the later cut.

events.what: Velocity shifts and roll/yaw tracking error at 9-12 s
events.why: A commanded roll manoeuvre that the aircraft followed.

events.what: Airspeed and yaw rate constant at 0 all recording
events.why: These channels never change; probably unavailable or unwired, but not examined further.

result.lesson: No earlier cases are in the workspace to apply.
result.reuse_when: Applies to a UAV with a mavros/PX4-style autopilot, a propulsion channel that follows throttle (corr ~1), and throttle dropping to 0 mid-flight without a logged mode event or failsafe.
